tactics: intro α inst xs y ys
simp only [List.removeAll, List.filter_filter, List.elem_cons, Bool.not_or, Bool.and_comm]
intro α inst xs y ys <;> induction xs <;> simp_all [List.removeAll, List.filter, List.elem_cons]
intro α inst xs y ys <;> unfold List.removeAll <;> rw [List.filter_filter] <;> apply List.filter_congr <;> intro x _ <;> cases x == y <;> simp
